notes: v2.0 (2026-07-19): Full job-family restructuring. Rebuilt the family list (21 -> 34 families) anchored on O*NET-SOC's 23 major groups (US Dept of Labor, public domain classification standard) plus LinkedIn's public job-function taxonomy, to close major coverage gaps the v1.1 list had for healthcare, skilled trades, manufacturing, protective services, arts, agriculture-as-work, and more. Merged four v1.1 near-duplicate pairs into single families: sales + sales_business_development -> sales; administrative_office + office_administration -> administrative_office; customer_support + customer_service -> customer_support_service; operations_program_mgmt + program_management -> split cleanly into operations and program_project_management. Split finance_accounting into finance and accounting (forward-looking financial planning vs. transactional record-keeping), per user request. Added 14 new families for coverage: engineering_technical, science_research, community_social_services, arts_design_media_entertainment, healthcare_clinical, healthcare_support, protective_service, supply_chain_procurement, building_grounds_maintenance, farming_fishing_forestry, construction_extraction, installation_maintenance_repair, production_manufacturing, transportation_material_moving, military. All existing v1.1 job_types were preserved and carried over into their new/merged family; a handful of new job_types were added under merged families for continuity (e.g. executive_assistant, technical_support). BREAKING CHANGE from v1.1: family IDs sales_business_development, office_administration, customer_support, customer_service, and finance_accounting no longer exist -- any stored structured.json referencing them under schema v1.0 should be treated as legacy and re-tagged against v2.0 on next parse; the JSON schema (v1.0) itself is unaffected since family_id is a free-text-matched field, not a schema-enforced enum. human_resources and talent_acquisition remain untouched, unmerged sibling families, since that distinction predates and is independent of this restructuring. Industries list (v1.1, unaffected by this change) still has agriculture_food_manufacturing added from a real-world test parse on 2026-07-18/19. This remains a living taxonomy, not exhaustive -- extend as new roles surface, per the existing v1.1 policy.

job_families.name: Human Resources & People Operations
job_families.description: HR & People Operations, employee lifecycle ownership from hire-acceptance onward: onboarding, HR operations, HRIS, payroll, comp & benefits, performance management, employee relations, policy & compliance, L&D, OD, DEI, engagement, offboarding. Excludes the talent-acquisition function (sibling family talent_acquisition).
